Current book figures that look wrong: (1) mat-c110-copper and mat-c101-bar at 56.86 PLN/kg are BELOW the delivered cathode metal value (LME 14,740 + Aurubis 315 = 57.95 PLN/kg) before any rolling/drawing charge - too low. (2) mat-brass-cz121 / mat-brass-cz122-forge 42.89 and mat-cz108-brass 42.61 are below the German brass metal bases (MS 58 48.07, MS 63/37 49.95 PLN/kg, 9 Sep 2026) before fabrication - likely too low (raw metal-content arithmetic gives 39.1 PLN/kg for CW614N, so the gap depends on which basis the trade uses). (3) mat-zamak3 16.14 and mat-zamak5 16.40 are below their own metal-content floors (16.61 / 17.01 PLN/kg) at Sep 2026 LME + Rotterdam premiums - too low. (4) mat-adc12 / mat-a380 10.65-10.84 match the January 2026 DIN226 print (10.85) but the primary premium and LME have risen since, so they are probably low for October; no later print found. (5) Magnesium alloys (AZ91D 19.28, AM60B 18.52) look high against a low-confidence ~11 PLN/kg European Mg ingot, but no alloy price was found, so not asserted. (6) mat-al-billet-6063 16.57 agrees with LME + DDP billet premium (16.75). (7) Aluminium sheet at 16.14 (5182) is only ~1.6 PLN/kg over P1020 (14.50) - looks thin for rolled sheet, but no rolling premium was found.
